gaia.epoch: midpoint of each pair's authoritative physical overlap interval
gaia.propagation: proper motion to registration epoch; include distance/RV perspective terms when physically usable; conservative PM-only fallback

interpretation_boundary: This contract freezes query/caching mechanics only. Gaia association and astrometric outcomes have not been read. Transport subdivision is not a scientific decision and cannot promote/reject a candidate.

offline_reference_construction.matching: reciprocal-nearest detector-candidate <-> epoch-propagated Gaia within 15 arcsec
offline_reference_construction.per_target_exclusion: exclude the target raw endpoints and any reference Gaia/source within 30 arcsec of the target midpoint before selecting local 5/10/20/30 arcmin window
offline_reference_construction.primary_reference: same Gaia source_id matched independently in both archives
offline_reference_construction.window_choice: smallest 5/10/20/30 arcmin window containing >=5 primary references

purpose: Scalable Gaia DR3 reference acquisition for the already-frozen candidate-independent primary/sparse astrometric registration.

science_parameters_unchanged.primary_fit: translation-only median; no clipping; no higher-order fit

transport_partition.candidate_domain: occupied cells are generated from all <=10 arcsec raw-match midpoints; no SNR/polarity/morphology/catalogue pruning
transport_partition.hpm_query_geometry: one high-PM pair-level cone containing every raw-match midpoint plus 900 arcsec; deduplicate by Gaia source_id
transport_partition.maxrec_recovery: recursively quarter only the affected transport cell until response is below MAXREC or cell size reaches 0.03125 deg; no science threshold changes
transport_partition.ordinary_query_geometry: one Gaia cone per occupied raw-match-midpoint cell; cone radius is spherical farthest cell corner plus 120 arcsec
